model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", is linear, spans from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", is linear, spans from 2.4 to 3.4, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The first line, colored purple and labeled "Vanilla", starts at approximately 3.3 and declines to approximately 2.55 by iteration 140000, exhibiting a steeper decline in the first 20000 iterations, then leveling off. The second line, colored orange and labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", begins at approximately 3.28 and decreases to approximately 2.56 by iteration 140000, following a similar declining trend to the first line. The third line, colored green and labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", starts at approximately 3.27 and declines to approximately 2.57 at iteration 140000, with a similar overall shape to the other lines. The fourth line, colored pink and labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starts at approximately 3.27 and decreases to approximately 2.56 at iteration 140000, closely tracking the other lines. Finally, the fifth line, colored blue and labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", starts at approximately 3.27 and declines to approximately 2.56 at iteration 140000, again exhibiting a similar pattern.
